title: Apple Updates MacBook Pro and iMac with M6 Chips
excerpt: Apple has refreshed the 14-inch MacBook Pro and iMac with its new M6 processors and up to 24 hours of battery life.
body_html:
Apple has announced updated versions of the 14-inch MacBook Pro and the iMac. The refreshed computers now feature the company's newest M6 processor.

According to the details, the updated devices are designed to offer enhanced performance alongside significant battery longevity, delivering up to 24 hours of battery life.
